text:
Grokbot template here: https://x.ai/bot/4VEl6mp1QrsvvjTFR-qE_

You should have it:
1) search a set of your info (name, cell, address, email), every day on every major search engine
2) log to incogni removal tool if not already there
3) if a search result is still visible from a page you’ve gotten removed, request the search engine refresh the page / re-index so it goes away
4) Email/harass sites that refuse incogni removal
5) request search engines suppress results that sites refuse to remove 

You can automate virtually everything and never think about it again
